title: Stow a footrest with its index latch
context: Clearing an empty footrest from a transfer space is useful when preparing an assistive device. The training module requires a separate hand to withdraw its latch before the footrest can swing. No person or occupant is present.
scoring: During the swing the latch must stay withdrawn by at least 25 mm after 8 degrees until the footrest first reaches 87 degrees. A later return below 80 degrees starts this requirement again. Violating it scores zero. The latch must first retract at least 25 mm. If the footrest rotates beyond 8 degrees before this happens the entire episode scores zero. Correct latch retraction earns 0.25. After that a footrest angle from 87 degrees to 92 degrees earns 0.5. Latch travel at most 3 mm with angular speed below 0.03 radians per second raises this to 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. At this angle the footplate clears the yellow transfer region by at least 10 mm. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: Rigid PA12 polymer props on ideal passive joints. A spring returns the separate pin into actual slots in the footrest index wheel. Contacts use 1 mm offsets. The latch has simulated clearance during final capture. Full score requires final index angle and rest rather than a proof load. The station is unoccupied and unpowered. No person or human load is simulated. Fracture and wear are omitted.
instruction: Stow the footrest module so the marked transfer space is clear. Pull the grey latch back and hold it while swinging the blue footrest through 90 degrees. Return the latch into the second index slot. Release both handles. The module is unoccupied and unpowered.
setup: Use the official bimanual YAM station. The tabletop is at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. All props are rigid PA12 polymer prototypes. All joint positions start at zero. The footrest module has an initial outer envelope of 100 by 200 by 82.5 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y 0 mm and z 747.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The spring latch has an initial outer envelope of 80 by 185 by 89 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y 115 mm and z 792.5 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The transfer space has an initial outer envelope of 160 by 110 by 1 mm. Its authored root is at x 160 mm and y -115 mm and z 748 mm. Its initial yaw is 0.0 radians. Its root is fixed to the tabletop. The inventory lists each collider and body mass and joint anchor and travel limit. Local solid positions are measured from the named body root. Outer envelope sizes describe the reset pose.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 120 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
